citations.quote: "mber 193300) is an autosomal-dominant inherited tumor predisposition syndrome. Patients with VHL are prone to the development of multiple neoplastic lesions including central nervous system hemangioblastomas (CHBs), retinal angiomas (RAs), renal cell carcinomas (RCCs), renal cysts, pancreatic tumors or cysts (PCTs), pheochromocytomas (PHEOs), endolymphatic-sac tumors, and papillary cystadenomas of the epididymis or broad ligament. The incidence of VHL disease is approximately 1 in 36000 live births and the overall penetrance is greater than 90% by age 65.\nVHL disease is caused by germline
